sources.title: PowerPyx - Red Dead Redemption 2 Gold Medals Guide
PowerPyx - Red Dead Redemption 2 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Red Dead Wiki (Fandom) - Missions in Redemption 2 + individual mission pages (read via MediaWiki API)
Red Dead Wiki (Fandom) - Missable Content in Redemption 2
Steam Community Guide - RDR2 Gold Medals, Challenges and 100% Completion Guide
GTABase - Red Dead Redemption 2 Missions list (and 'Red Dead Redemption' mission page)
RDR2.org - Red Dead Redemption 2 Endings Guide

knownTotals.note: Excludes Special Edition 'High and Low Finance' and the no-medal missions Money Lending V, American Fathers I (cutscene), Lost and Not Quite Found (cutscene).
Includes A Fork in the Road and That's Murfree Country; Icarus and Friends counts as Chapter 6.

Includes Icarus and Friends and the honor missions DNSA I, DNSA II, Course of True Love V, Archeology for Beginners, Honor Amongst Thieves, Mrs. Sadie Adler Widow II. Excludes no-medal Course of True Love IV, Mrs Sadie Adler Widow I, Money Lending VI & VII, Of Men and Angels.
'The Best of Women' (cutscene) has no medal.
70 golds needed for 'Gold Rush'. GTABase says 105 because it counts Special Edition 'High and Low Finance' (see disputes).
GTABase count of all story missions incl. no-medal ones and the SE mission; PowerPyx roadmap says 108 main missions. Informational only.

missions.name: The Joys of Civilization
goldRequirements: Catch the street urchin before he reaches the market
Complete within 5 minutes 30 seconds
goldTips: Skip the horse the mission offers and use your own bonded horse to keep pace with the kid.
Cut corners instead of following the kid's exact route (e.g. climb the walls to reach the next street and wait where he drops down).
Shooting the coach he jumps onto stops it, but risks alerting the law and failing the mission.
missableNotes: Unlocks the Saint Denis gunsmith Semi-Automatic Pistol for purchase (per steamgm weapon list).

missions.name: Angelo Bronte, a Man of Honor
missions.spoilerFreeTitle: A Meeting with a Saint Denis Boss
goldRequirements: Encounter the dog and the drunk
Don't get spotted by the law
Complete within 10 minutes 40 seconds
Get 4 headshots
goldTips: The timer is very strict: after meeting the dog and the drunk, go straight to the grave-robbing site on the right instead of waiting for John.
The last grave robber tends to run back towards where the dog was; chase him down immediately.
steamgm reports the 5th grave robber occasionally fails to spawn; restart the game if so. Many players call this one of the hardest golds - a good candidate to skip for the 70.

missions.name: Help a Brother Out
goldRequirements: Find the captives without threatening the store owner
Complete within 2 minutes 45 seconds
goldTips: On entering the fence's shop go straight to the bookshelf clue and pull the shelf - do not intimidate the owner.
missableNotes: Optional Honor mission required for 'Lending a Hand'. Missable: only available in Chapter 4 (ends with 'Banking, The Old American Art').
Must be completed to unlock 'Brothers and Sisters, One and All', which in turn unlocks the Chapter 6 honor mission 'Of Men and Angels'.

missions.name: Brothers and Sisters, One and All
missions.startLocation: Saint Denis (church area, appears some in-game hours after 'Help a Brother Out')
goldRequirements: Find the kid within 19 seconds
goldTips: When you reach the injured man, ignore him and run straight down the right-hand path at the crossroads to find the kid.
missableNotes: Optional Honor mission required for 'Lending a Hand'. Missable after Chapter 4.
Required to unlock the Chapter 6 honor mini-quest 'Of Men and Angels' (also required for 'Lending a Hand').

missions.name: Fatherhood and Other Dreams (II)
missions.giver: Mary Linton (start by reading her letter at camp)
goldRequirements: Catch the wagon and take it to the secluded spot within 1 minute 45 seconds
Take Mary to the theater
goldTips: When the coach bolts, grab a nearby horse (no honor loss) or your own bonded horse and chase immediately.
Take the shortcut on the right when the wagon turns in Bayou Nwa.
At the end, accept Mary's suggestion to go to the theater.
missableNotes: Optional Honor mission required for 'Lending a Hand'; missable after Chapter 4. Only unlocks after 'Angelo Bronte, a Man of Honor'.

missions.name: No, No and Thrice, No
goldRequirements: Kill both of the Foreman boys yourself during the chase
Complete with at least 90% accuracy
goldTips: Use Dead Eye during the chase; if you are slow, Susan kills one brother and the objective fails.
Missing more than a shot or two breaks the 90% accuracy - tag body shots in Dead Eye if you miss.
missableNotes: If Arthur kills Anthony Foreman here, the Epilogue bounty on Anthony Foreman is unavailable (fandom Missable Content page; not a trophy item).

missions.name: The Gilded Cage
missions.giver: Hosea Matthews & Dutch van der Linde
goldRequirements: While at the party, pour some drinks, compliment a guest's attire, accept a gift and save a life
Follow the servant without being detected
goldTips: Drinks: the three women at the foot of the right-hand stairway. Gift: the two gentlemen behind them (accept the opera ticket). Attire: the woman in the exotic hat near the band gazebo. Save a life: the choking man near Hosea (it is Algernon Wasp).
Keep a large gap while following the servant Pierre; getting close gets you spotted.

missions.name: American Fathers (II)
missions.giver: Eagle Flies (part I is a cutscene with Rains Fall/Evelyn Miller at the Saint Denis courthouse)
missions.startLocation: Near Cornwall Kerosene & Tar, Heartland Oil Fields
goldRequirements: Infiltrate the factory by hiding in the wagon
Reach Danbury's office without being detected
Kill all the horseback pursuers during the escape
Complete with at least 80% accuracy
goldTips: Crouch-sprint along the left side upstairs to reach the office quickly.
Known glitch: the two horseback pursuers can crash into the entrance post and die on their own, failing the objective - look behind you as the escape starts and Dead Eye both of them immediately.
missableNotes: Optional branch (not needed to finish Chapter 4) but it has a gold medal; unavailable after Chapter 4 ends (replayable after the story).

missions.name: A Fine Night of Debauchery
goldRequirements: Win the game of Poker without Strauss's help
After your cover is blown, escape the boat in under 35 seconds
Get 5 headshots
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Fold the first hand (it always loses); go all-in on the next hands, which are rigged in your favour.
Once the shooting starts, get the 5 headshots from the first cover, vault the bar and push forward; leave only when Javier says to go (leaving early fails the mission).
missableNotes: Unlocks the Semi-Auto Shotgun at gunsmiths (steamgm weapon list).

missions.name: Horsemen, Apocalypses
goldRequirements: Shoot the O'Driscolls in the boat before they disembark
Complete using only sidearms
Complete with at least 70% accuracy
Get 15 headshots
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Stay in position and farm headshots with Dead Eye instead of immediately following Dutch's prompts.
The boat O'Driscolls appear to the right of Sadie after she kills three enemies - head there when Arthur asks why Sadie isn't going inside.

missions.name: Urban Pleasures
goldRequirements: Rob all the customers in the trolley station
Kill 10 lawmen while on the trolley
Prevent any lawmen jumping on the back of the wagon
Shoot the dynamite Lenny throws
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Dead Eye-only tonics do not count as health items - bring plenty.
Equip the double-barrel Sawed-Off Shotgun as a sidearm to hit Lenny's dynamite at the bridge out of town.
No accuracy requirement, so prioritise killing riders quickly.

missions.name: Country Pursuits
goldRequirements: Return Jules to the skiff within 1 minute 40 seconds
Shoot the Bullgator 5 times
goldTips: First-person mode helps you move through the water to Jules; sprint the whole way back (Arthur does not tire here).

missions.name: Revenge is a Dish Best Eaten
goldRequirements: Search every room in Bronte's mansion
Carry Bronte to the skiff within 1 minute 30 seconds
Get 20 headshots
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Search the rooms left and right of the stairway before the middle room.
Shotgun kills may not register as headshots because of pellet spread - use a revolver/repeater.
missableNotes: Missable documents in this mission: 'List of Accounts' and 'Telegram to Police Chief Lambert' (fandom; documents are not trophy items).

missions.name: Banking, The Old American Art
missions.spoilerFreeTitle: The Big City Bank Job (Chapter 4 finale)
goldRequirements: Crack the safe without making any mistakes
Complete using only sidearms
Get 25 headshots
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Safe combination is always 19, 72, 54 - turn slowly as you approach each number (controller vibrates strongly near the right number).
Take plenty of Dead Eye tonics and sidearm ammo; on replay you have limited supplies.
steamgm reports the mission is buggy on replay (companions can stop during the ride).
missableNotes: POINT OF NO RETURN for Chapter 4. Finish everything first: the camp trophies 'Give to the Poor' ($250 tithing box), 'Errand Boy' (5 item requests) and 'Friends With Benefits' (companion activity in the Ch2, Ch3 and Ch4 camps) all become unobtainable after this mission.
Chapter 4 optional honor missions (Help a Brother Out, Brothers and Sisters One and All, Fatherhood and Other Dreams I & II, Money Lending and Other Sins V) are lost after this mission.
The Chapter 4 camp companion activities (incl. the Special Edition bank robbery 'High and Low Finance') expire here.
After this mission you temporarily lose your weapons, money, horses and journal until you return from the Chapter 5 island (they are restored).
Completing Chapter 4 awards the 'Washed Ashore' story trophy (automatic).

missions.name: Welcome to the New World
goldRequirements: Do not fall behind while walking with the chain gang
Get 10 headshots
goldTips: Your Dead Eye core starts drained - rely on normal aimed shots and save Dead Eye for groups.
You have no provisions at the start, so avoid unnecessary damage.
missableNotes: Guarma is a separate island you can never return to after Chapter 5 (except via mission replay).

missions.name: Savagery Unleashed
goldRequirements: Release all the workers within 4 seconds
Complete within 5 minutes 40 seconds
Get 8 headshots
goldTips: Enter Dead Eye, tag the soldier doing the hanging first, then the three ropes.
Follow Leon's instructions promptly so he keeps moving.
missableNotes: Sun Hat can be looted from enemies in the Guarma missions (missable hat, not trophy-related).

missions.name: A Kind and Benevolent Despot
goldRequirements: Get Javier to safety in under 2 minutes
Get 10 headshots
goldTips: Push ahead of Dutch during the escape and clear spawning soldiers; if you fall behind he stops and wastes time.
In the sugar fields stay behind Dutch and shoot only soldiers that appear behind you; use short Dead Eye bursts.

missions.name: Hell Hath No Fury
goldRequirements: Prevent 4 boats from reaching the shore
Destroy the naval ship without missing a shot
Complete with at least 70% accuracy
goldTips: Aim cannon shots at the ship's funnel and wait for the camera shake to stop before firing so no shot misses.

missions.name: Paradise Mercifully Departed
goldRequirements: Kill the first 2 sentries without being spotted
Escort the captain to the boat within 1 minute 45 seconds
Complete within 6 minutes 45 seconds
Get 25 headshots
goldTips: Kill the right-hand sentry as soon as Micah starts moving on the minimap, or Micah alerts the other one.
missableNotes: POINT OF NO RETURN for Guarma: after this mission you cannot go back to the island. Guarma-only animals (3 macaws, 4 snakes, red-footed booby) are NOT needed for 'Zoologist' or 'Skin Deep'.
'Extreme Personality' (max/min honor) cannot pop until this mission is done (ppxt).

missions.name: Dear Uncle Tacitus
goldRequirements: Leave Shady Belle without being detected by the Pinkertons
Complete within 8 minutes
goldTips: When the Pinkertons enter Shady Belle, wait a second then crouch-walk out behind them.
missableNotes: Your gear and horses are restored on return; Arthur has roughly $450 on him afterwards (fandom).

missions.name: Fleeting Joy
goldRequirements: Kill 2 Pinkertons during the Dead Eye ambush
Get 5 headshots with the Gatling Gun
Get at least 70% accuracy with the Gatling Gun
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Avoid Dead Eye in the first shootout so you have a full core for the Maxim/Gatling section.
On the Gatling Gun only fire in Dead Eye at locked targets; once you have 5 headshots get off the gun to protect your accuracy.
missableNotes: Shady Belle / Lakay camp content ends; the gang relocates to Beaver Hollow.

missions.name: A Fork in the Road
missions.giver: Doctor (Saint Denis) - triggered by Arthur collapsing in Saint Denis
goldRequirements: Complete within 3 minutes 5 seconds
goldTips: After leaving the doctor's office take the road on the left and walk straight to the crossroads to end the mission.
steamgm: if a pedestrian blocks your path on the way to the doctor you may miss the time - restart.
missableNotes: Unlocks the Chapter 6 optional honor missions 'Do Not Seek Absolution' (Annesburg) and 'Of Men and Angels' (Saint Denis).

missions.name: That's Murfree Country
goldRequirements: Deliver Meredith to her mother within 2 minutes
Get 15 headshots
Complete with at least 85% accuracy
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Choose to go on horseback rather than by canoe - your own horse is faster than the village horse.
When delivering Meredith, take the left downhill shortcut at the three-way junction and ride straight into Annesburg.
You can kill the two patrolling Murfrees without waiting for Charles.
missableNotes: Completing this mission advances into Chapter 6 (Beaver Hollow). Awards the 'No Traitors' Chapter 5 trophy (automatic).
Scarred Murfree horses (Black Rabicano Tennessee Walker / Blanket Appaloosa) can be taken here (missable horses, not trophy items).

missions.name: Icarus and Friends
goldRequirements: Keep the balloon at the correct altitude for the entire journey
Get 5 headshots from the balloon
Complete with at least 70% accuracy
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Only the flight to the prison island counts for the altitude objective.
Tag and fire immediately in Dead Eye for the balloon headshots; after the crash use body shots to protect accuracy.
missableNotes: Can be played in Chapter 5 but is listed under Chapter 6 in the replay menu.

missions.name: Visiting Hours
goldRequirements: Get headshots on both prison guards when sniping from the tower
Escape to the boat within 2 minutes 45 seconds
Complete within 9 minutes
Complete with at least 80% accuracy
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: During the escape run to cover rather than fighting, kill the five mounted guards, then crouch-run through the bushes to the boat.
Often rated one of the hardest golds (steamgm 5/5).

missions.name: Just a Social Call
goldRequirements: Headshot 3 mounted enemies
After killing Cornwall, reach the horses within 2 minutes 45 seconds
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Keep moving while shooting to make the time limit; Dead Eye the riders as soon as they spawn during the horseback escape.
missableNotes: Newsboy Cap can be looted from enemies (missable hat).

missions.name: Do Not Seek Absolution I
goldRequirements: Complete within 1 minute 20 seconds
missableNotes: Optional Honor mission for 'Lending a Hand'. Requires honor of at least level 4 of 8 (ppxt) and becomes available after 'A Fork in the Road'. Lost after Chapter 6.

missions.name: Do Not Seek Absolution II
goldRequirements: Find Edith Downes within 1 minute 10 seconds
missableNotes: Optional Honor mission for 'Lending a Hand'; lost after Chapter 6.

missions.name: The Course of True Love V
missions.giver: Penelope Braithwaite (part IV starts from her letter at Beaver Hollow)
goldRequirements: Headshot 5 of the Braithwaites as they pursue the train
Complete within 7 minutes 30 seconds
goldTips: Very strict timer: cut left across the Braithwaite fields to the station and keep the train at full throttle.
missableNotes: Optional Honor mission (IV & V) for 'Lending a Hand'; requires Course of True Love I-III from Chapter 3. Lost after Chapter 6.

missions.name: The Delights of Van Horn
goldRequirements: Headshot 5 soldiers with a long scoped rifle
Complete with at least 85% accuracy
goldTips: Use Dead Eye for the 5 scoped headshots, then switch to a repeater/rifle for the mounted soldiers to protect accuracy.

missions.name: The Bridge to Nowhere
goldRequirements: Plant the dynamite within 1 minute 35 seconds
Escape the oncoming train within 19 seconds

missions.name: A Rage Unleashed
goldRequirements: Knock out 2 soldiers on the boat
Round up the horses and reach shore within 1 minute 30 seconds
goldTips: Keep weapons holstered when ambushing so Arthur knocks out rather than kills.
Swim to the nearest horse, mount and sprint straight to shore.

missions.name: Archeology for Beginners
missions.spoilerFreeTitle: A Sacred Site with Rains Fall
goldRequirements: Recover the relics without being detected
Recover the relics within 1 minute 30 seconds
goldTips: Remount after Arthur first dismounts and ride to the army camp; crouch-sprint via the rock by the horses to the Chanupa, then back behind the barrel.
Use bushes for cover; a known bug can have an outer soldier spot you even while in stealth - leave quickly if so.
missableNotes: Optional Honor mission for 'Lending a Hand'; lost after Chapter 6.
Do not kill anyone to receive the Owl Feather trinket (missable trinket).
Accept Captain Monroe's request during this mission to unlock 'Honor, Amongst Thieves'.

missions.name: Honor, Amongst Thieves
goldRequirements: Recover the vaccine without being detected
Complete within 5 minutes
goldTips: Approach the wagon on its right side at normal (not full) gallop and wait for the prompt before jumping aboard.
missableNotes: Optional Honor mission for 'Lending a Hand'; only offered if you accept Monroe's request in 'Archeology for Beginners'. Lost after Chapter 6.

missions.name: The Fine Art of Conversation
goldRequirements: Kill a pursuer's horse during the escape
Complete within 9 minutes 30 seconds
Complete with at least 75% accuracy
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: No headshot requirement - body shots with a shotgun keep accuracy high; Dead Eye a pursuer's horse during the chase.
missableNotes: 'Of Men and Angels' (Sister Calderon, Saint Denis) becomes unavailable after this mission (fandom) - do it first; it is required for 'Lending a Hand'.

missions.name: Goodbye, Dear Friend
missions.spoilerFreeTitle: A Public Event in Saint Denis
missions.giver: Sadie Adler / Dutch van der Linde
goldRequirements: Find Colm's backup within 45 seconds
Get 8 headshots with a long scoped rifle
Complete within 6 minutes 30 seconds
goldTips: Go straight up the ladder, through the window and right to the sniper; have your knife ready to finish him fast.
The scope moves slowly and auto-tracks Dutch at first; tag in Dead Eye then cancel it to move faster. Start with full Dead Eye.
missableNotes: Awards the 'Third Time Lucky' story trophy (automatic).

missions.name: Mrs. Sadie Adler, Widow (II)
goldRequirements: Headshot the sniper in the barn
Secure the barn without taking any damage
Complete within 5 minutes 30 seconds
goldTips: Use a rifle/repeater and peek from cover briefly; go around the barn and shoot the last O'Driscoll through the window.
missableNotes: Optional Honor mission (I & II) for 'Lending a Hand'; lost after Chapter 6.
fandom: completing this before 'Money Lending and Other Sins VI & VII' can make those debt missions disappear - do the debts first.

missions.name: Favored Sons
goldRequirements: Kill the soldier on the cannon within 45 seconds
Get 35 headshots
Complete the mission without taking any health items

missions.name: The King's Son
goldRequirements: While infiltrating Fort Wallace, headshot every soldier blocking your way to Eagle Flies
Kill 15 enemies while escaping in the canoe
Complete with at least 80% accuracy
goldTips: Wait for Charles's command to shoot paired guards together with the bow.

missions.name: My Last Boy
goldRequirements: Save Paytah
Get 30 headshots
Complete with at least 80% accuracy
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Paytah is struggling with a soldier by a train car on the left after you cross the Gatling-gun train - kill that soldier.
Bring rifles/repeaters; body-shot a few enemies if accuracy slips.

missions.name: Our Best Selves
goldRequirements: Get a headshot in Dead Eye after jumping from Dutch's horse
Complete within 11 minutes
Fight through the train with at least 80% accuracy
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: After leaping onto the train, Dead Eye-headshot the soldier who knocks John off.
Accuracy stops counting once you reach the Maxim gun - be careful before that point.
missableNotes: This mission rolls straight into the Chapter 6 finale; make a manual save BEFORE starting it if you want an Arthur save to return to (see 'Red Dead Redemption').

missions.name: Red Dead Redemption
missions.giver: Abigail Roberts / story (auto-continues from 'Our Best Selves')
goldRequirements: Get 7 headshots while covering Sadie from the lighthouse
After Sadie is captured, reach Abigail and Sadie within 1 minute
Complete with at least 70% accuracy
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: After Sadie is captured, run left through the houses to avoid a Pinkerton's line of fire, kill the one at the dock and rush in.
No overall headshot/time limit beyond the lighthouse section - take careful shots for accuracy.
Since patch 1.15 replays keep your stats, 3 of each tonic and your chosen horse (fandom).
missableNotes: POINT OF NO RETURN: after this mission you play as John and never control Arthur again. Make a separate manual save beforehand.

Lost at this point: all Chapter 6 optional honor missions ('Lending a Hand'), Arthur's money, all of Arthur's horses (including stabled ones), the Beaver Hollow camp, O'Driscoll compendium entries (they are replaced by the Laramie gang), Charlotte Balfour encounters if not all seen as Arthur, and Gertrude Braithwaite's journal point of interest.

Carries over to John: weapons, outfits, satchel items (kit, trinkets, talismans, valuables, documents), collectibles such as cigarette cards. Tip: hold unused treasure maps/valuables until the Epilogue.
Workaround reported by fandom: letting Arthur be robbed at the Aberdeen Pig Farm before 'Our Best Selves' lets John recover that money in the Epilogue.
Ending choice (help John vs go back for the money) and Arthur's honor only change the ending scenes; no trophy depends on them. The 'Redemption' trophy unlocks on completion either way.

missions.name: The Wheel
goldRequirements: Reach Pronghorn Ranch without dropping any supplies
Reclaim the wagon within 1 minute
missableNotes: Knock John's hat off and pick it up to save the Worn Flat Cap (missable hat).
The horse Rachel becomes John's after this mission (unique horse).

missions.name: Simple Pleasures
goldRequirements: When milking, fill a bucket within 10 seconds
Complete within 5 minutes 15 seconds
missableNotes: John's Gambler's Hat must be knocked off and picked up to be saved (missable hat).

missions.name: Farming, for Beginners
goldRequirements: Fix the first section of fence in 1 minute 30 seconds
Avoid being hit by the bull
goldTips: Jump onto the large rock beside the bull's charge path before throwing the rope; at the end rope it, release and run onto the wagon by the barn.
steamgm: being dragged while lassoing does not void the objective.

missions.name: Fatherhood, for Beginners
goldRequirements: Tire out Jeremiah within 45 seconds
Feed Jeremiah a treat
Teach Jack to ride without his horse bucking him off
Win the race back to Pronghorn Ranch
goldTips: Spam jump while riding forward to drain Jeremiah's stamina fast.
Tell Jack to speed up only once so his horse keeps cantering.

missions.name: Old Habits
goldRequirements: Defeat the Laramie without taking a hit
Defeat the Laramie within 25 seconds
goldTips: Dodge backwards first, then spam attack until the scripted choke-slam; avoid grapples.
steamgm: the no-hit objective is occasionally buggy - just retry.

missions.name: Jim Milton Rides, Again?
goldRequirements: Get 10 kills while dual wielding sidearms
Get 15 headshots
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: steamgm: the headshot counter sometimes fails to register - retry if so.

missions.name: Fatherhood, for Idiots
missions.spoilerFreeTitle: A Trip to Strawberry with Jack
goldRequirements: Kill all 3 enemies in Dead Eye
After the confrontation, return to Pronghorn Ranch within 1 minute 30 seconds

missions.name: Motherhood
goldRequirements: Complete within 1 minute 30 seconds

missions.name: Gainful Employment
goldRequirements: After arriving in Strawberry, locate the bounty within 30 seconds
After mounting your horse, catch and hogtie the bounty within 1 minute 15 seconds
goldTips: Skip questioning townsfolk; go straight to the Strawberry Welcome Center/hotel room upstairs by the bathroom.
Killing the bounty's horse (small honor loss) or cutting straight across at the rail crossing makes the hogtie easy.

missions.name: Home of the Gentry?
missions.giver: Ansel Atherton (bank, Blackwater) - after the no-medal cutscene 'The Landowning Classes'
goldRequirements: Complete within 2 minutes 30 seconds
missableNotes: John takes a bank loan to buy Beecher's Hope here. The debt cannot be paid off with your own cash - it is cleared through the Epilogue Part 2 story.

missions.name: Bare Knuckle Friendships
missions.spoilerFreeTitle: Finding an Old Friend in Saint Denis
goldRequirements: After arriving in Saint Denis, find Charles within 1 minute 50 seconds
Kill all of Guido Martelli's men within 10 seconds
goldTips: Go to the fence rather than the bar, speak to the shopkeeper at the door and leave immediately for the next location.
Dead Eye-tag all of Martelli's men at once.

missions.name: Home Improvement for Beginners
goldRequirements: Complete within 18 seconds
goldTips: Do not skip the cutscene (skipping adds load time that counts).
missableNotes: ppxt (Patch 1.03): replaying this mission after the story was reported to unlock 'Lending a Hand' instantly if missed - may have been patched; do not rely on it.

missions.name: An Honest Day's Labors
goldRequirements: Kill all of Langton's men during the horseback escape
After choosing your approach, escape with Shane Finley within 5 minutes
Complete with at least 70% accuracy
Complete the mission without taking any health items

missions.name: The Tool Box
goldRequirements: Headshot all Skinner Brothers hiding up trees
Find Mr. Wayne within 2 minutes 15 seconds
Complete using only sidearms
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Dual-wield; hip-fire the machete rushers (no accuracy requirement).
When Charles mentions the tree ambushers, Dead Eye-tag their heads carefully.

missions.name: A New Jerusalem
goldRequirements: Hammer the nails in with 80% accuracy
Complete within 3 minutes 35 seconds
goldTips: Sources differ on technique: fandom suggests rapidly pressing the button; steamgm suggests holding it for a split second per nail.
missableNotes: Awards the 'Cowboy Builder' story trophy (automatic).

missions.name: A Quick Favor for an Old Friend
goldRequirements: Force Cortez's men to flee from Rhodes within 30 seconds
Get 5 headshots while covering Sadie with a long scoped rifle
Get 4 hip fire kills
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Get the hip-fire kills with a shotgun right at the start of the ambush.
Use high-damage weapons to clear Rhodes quickly.

missions.name: Uncle's Bad Day
goldRequirements: Get 5 headshots using the bow
After freeing Uncle, return to Beecher's Hope within 3 minutes 10 seconds
Complete with at least 80% accuracy
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Dead Eye-tagged bow shots home in, making the 5 bow headshots easy.
Stay just ahead of Charles and Uncle clearing enemies so they keep moving; kill the three Skinners that spawn behind them near the horses quickly.

missions.name: Trying Again
goldRequirements: Catch a fish
Complete within 5 minutes 20 seconds
goldTips: Land a fish before Jack asks about Rufus, then put the rod away immediately.

missions.name: A Really Big Bastard
goldRequirements: Shoot the bear 4 times as it charges
Headshot both the rival bounty hunters in Dead Eye
Complete within 7 minutes 15 seconds

missions.name: A New Future Imagined
goldRequirements: Complete within 7 minutes 30 seconds

missions.name: American Venom
goldRequirements: Help Sadie catch Cleet within 35 seconds
Headshot the sniper who shoots Charles
Complete with at least 85% accuracy
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Bring a repeater with high-velocity ammo and a scoped bolt-action rifle.
For the sniper: advance with Sadie to the rocks nearest him, wait for the prompt, then lean out in Dead Eye and tag his head. Peeking early gets John killed.
85% accuracy - favour body shots.
missableNotes: Completing this finishes the story: 'Endless Summer' trophy (automatic), $20,000 reward, end credits, then free roam as John at Beecher's Hope.
After the credits every story mission (including missed optional ones) can be replayed from Pause > Progress > Story for gold medals; replays do not count for 'Lending a Hand' (ppxt).
Micah's Revolver can be picked up at the final showdown location on Mount Hagen afterwards (steamgm).

missions.name: High and Low Finance
missions.giver: Charles Smith (camp companion activity, Special/Ultimate Edition only)
goldRequirements: Complete within 5 minutes 45 seconds
Don't take any damage during the escape
missableNotes: Special/Ultimate Edition content only; counts as the Chapter 4 companion activity for 'Friends With Benefits'. Expires at the end of Chapter 4.
NOT counted in the 104 medal missions used for 'Gold Rush' by PowerPyx/steamgm; see disputes.

missables.what: Camp trophies 'Give to the Poor', 'Errand Boy' and 'Friends With Benefits'
missables.deadline: Before completing 'Banking, The Old American Art' (end of Chapter 4)
missables.recommendedTiming: Chapters 2-4; finish in Chapter 4 at the latest before starting the bank job
missables.why: The tithing box, companion item requests and companion activities only exist in the Chapter 2-4 camps.
howTo: Donate $250 total (cash or valuables) to the camp tithing box.
Complete at least one companion activity in each of the Chapter 2, 3 and 4 camps.

missables.what: Chapter 4 optional honor missions: Help a Brother Out, Brothers and Sisters One and All, Fatherhood and Other Dreams I & II, Money Lending and Other Sins V
missables.recommendedTiming: As soon as each unlocks in Chapter 4
missables.why: Optional story missions expire at chapter end and are required for 'Lending a Hand'; Brothers and Sisters also gates the Chapter 6 mini-quest Of Men and Angels.
howTo: Talk to Brother Dorkins in Saint Denis for Help a Brother Out, then return some in-game hours later for Brothers and Sisters.
Read Mary Linton's letter at camp for Fatherhood and Other Dreams.
Take the debt from Strauss at camp for Money Lending V (do not rob/knock out the Davisons' homestead first).

missables.what: Chapter 6 optional honor missions: Do Not Seek Absolution I & II, Of Men and Angels I & II, The Course of True Love IV & V, Archeology for Beginners, Honor Amongst Thieves, Money Lending and Other Sins VI & VII, Mrs. Sadie Adler Widow I & II
missables.deadline: Before 'Red Dead Redemption' (Of Men and Angels: before 'The Fine Art of Conversation')
missables.recommendedTiming: Early in Chapter 6 before advancing the main story
missables.why: All expire when Arthur's story ends. Do Not Seek Absolution needs honor level 4 of 8. Money Lending VI & VII can disappear if Mrs. Sadie Adler Widow is done first.
howTo: Do Money Lending VI & VII before Mrs. Sadie Adler, Widow.
Visit Sister Calderon in Saint Denis before The Fine Art of Conversation.
Accept Captain Monroe's request during Archeology for Beginners.

missables.what: Everything tied to Arthur: his cash, his horses (including stabled ones), the gang camp, Arthur-only encounters
missables.recommendedTiming: Keep a manual save before 'Our Best Selves'
missables.why: Control passes permanently to John. Weapons, outfits and satchel items transfer; money and horses do not. No trophy requires Arthur-only content beyond the honor missions, but the save lets you revisit Arthur.
howTo: Spend Arthur's cash before the finale (or use the Aberdeen Pig Farm trick per fandom).
Do not sell treasure-map valuables yet - they carry over.
Make a separate manual save before 'Our Best Selves'.

missables.what: Guarma island (Chapter 5) content - exclusive animals, Sun Hat
missables.why: The island cannot be revisited. Guarma-exclusive animals are not needed for 'Zoologist' or 'Skin Deep'; Cuban Land Crab and Green Iguana also spawn on the mainland (Flat Iron Lake island).
howTo: Optionally study/skin Guarma animals while there for completeness only.

notes: Gold medal requirements were cross-checked across PowerPyx, Red Dead Wiki mission pages and the Steam 100% guide; all 63 Chapter 4-Epilogue lists match in substance (only wording/typos differ). (sources: ppx, fandom, steamgm)

All objectives for a gold must be met in a single run of the mission; a replay resets progress on every objective. Since patch 1.15, replays give reasonable stats/tonics/your horse. (sources: ppx, steamgm, fandom)
The gold checklist is not shown on the first playthrough, but objectives still count if met. Recommended: manual save before each mission and reload if a gold fails. (sources: ppx)

Chapter trophies in this range are automatic: Washed Ashore (Ch4), No Traitors (Ch5), Third Time Lucky ('Goodbye, Dear Friend'), Redemption ('Red Dead Redemption'), Cowboy Builder ('A New Jerusalem'), Endless Summer (finish Epilogue). (sources: ppxt, fandom)

Ending choice in 'Red Dead Redemption' (help John escape vs go back for the money) plus Arthur's honor changes the finale scenes; no trophy depends on the ending or honor at that point. 'Extreme Personality' (max or min honor) can be earned any time after Guarma, including post-game as John. (sources: ppxt, fandom, rdr2org-endings)
John's honor affects gameplay (e.g. store discounts) but not the story. (sources: fandom)

Epilogue: John works at Pronghorn Ranch (Part 1), then buys Beecher's Hope with a bank loan (Part 2). The loan cannot be paid down with cash you hold; the story clears it. Completing 'American Venom' pays $20,000 and returns free roam at Beecher's Hope. (sources: fandom, ppxt)
Arthur's items that carry over to John: weapons, outfits, kit, trinkets, talismans, valuables, documents; NOT money or horses. Stabled horses are lost too. (sources: fandom)
Chapter 4 ending temporarily strips weapons, money, horses and journal until the Guarma chapter ends; they are restored in 'Dear Uncle Tacitus'. (sources: fandom)
PowerPyx comment section (single user report): unfinished bounty wanted posters held by Arthur are removed after Chapter 6. Treat as unverified. (sources: ppxt)

disputes.topic: Total gold medal missions: 104 vs 105 (High and Low Finance)
disputes.details: Special/Ultimate Edition companion mission 'High and Low Finance' (Charles bank robbery, Chapter 4) has gold objectives. GTABase counts 105 medal missions; PowerPyx and the Steam guide count 104 and the Steam guide states it does not count toward 'Gold Rush'. A PowerPyx commenter says it appears in the Chapter 4 story tab.

positions.claim: 104 medal missions; HLF does not count toward the 70
105 missions have gold objectives including HLF

disputes.suggestedHandling: Show 104 as the trophy-relevant total and list HLF separately as an optional Special Edition extra that may not count.

disputes.details: PowerPyx lists 'Horsemen, Apocalypse', 'American Fathers - II', 'Fatherhood and Other Dreams - II', 'Mrs. Sadie Adler, Widow - II', 'The Course of True Love - V', 'Bare Knuckles Friendships', 'That's Murfee Country'. Fandom/Steam use 'Horsemen, Apocalypses', 'Bare Knuckle Friendships', 'That's Murfree Country' and describe the multi-part missions as I & II / IV & V where only the later part carries the medal.
disputes.suggestedHandling: Use fandom spellings; note that the medal belongs to the final part (II or V) of multi-part honor missions.

disputes.topic: Chapter assignment of Icarus and Friends, A Fork in the Road, That's Murfree Country
disputes.details: Icarus and Friends can be played before That's Murfree Country (i.e. during Chapter 5) but is filed under Chapter 6 in the replay menu. Fandom's flowchart treats A Fork in the Road / That's Murfree Country as leading into Chapter 6, while PowerPyx, Steam and GTABase list both under Chapter 5.

positions.claim: Fork in the Road and Murfree Country are Chapter 5; Icarus is Chapter 6
Icarus playable in Ch5 but counted as Ch6 on replay

disputes.suggestedHandling: Use the replay-menu grouping (Ch5: 9 missions incl. Fork & Murfree; Ch6: 19 incl. Icarus) and mention Icarus can be played early.

disputes.details: Many Chapter 4 and 6 missions are branching/optional and can be done in different orders (fandom calculates millions of sequences). Chapter 5 'Savagery Unleashed' and 'A Kind and Benevolent Despot' can be done in either order (Steam/GTABase list Savagery first, PowerPyx lists Despot first).
disputes.suggestedHandling: orderInChapter is a typical order (GTABase/Steam), not mandatory; tell players to follow available markers.

disputes.details: RDR2.org describes the ending as depending only on the final choice (money vs John). Fandom describes four variants: each choice has a high-honor and low-honor version. Neither affects trophies.

positions.claim: Ending depends entirely on the final choice
Four endings: choice x Arthur's honor level

disputes.suggestedHandling: Say the finale varies with both the choice and honor; no trophy depends on it.

disputes.details: PowerPyx (patch 1.03 era) reports that replaying 'Home Improvement for Beginners' after the story unlocked 'Lending a Hand' even with missed honor missions; it may have been patched since.
disputes.suggestedHandling: Mention as an unverified fallback only; tell players to do every honor mission on the main playthrough.

disputes.details: Fandom advises rapidly pressing the prompt; the Steam guide advises holding the button briefly for each nail. Requirement text (80% nail accuracy) is the same.
